vrf_air_conditioning.prompt: I've designed a small, single-zone building model. Please add a complete VRF air-conditioning system that can provide both heating and cooling for this zone. Use realistic, default settings suitable for a small office or apartment — for example, efficient indoor and outdoor units with typical performance. Automatically include everything needed: indoor unit, outdoor unit, fans, cooling and heating coils, thermostats, and temperature schedules. Please make sure the system: Connects properly to the single zone in the model, Uses automatic sizing for airflow and capacity, Has reasonable setpoints (around 24°C for cooling and 21°C for heating)

vrf_all_components.prompt: Design a complete VRF HVAC system to my one-zone building.Include all indoor and outdoor units, fans, coils for heating and cooling, thermostats, and schedules. Use normal default values, autosize everything, and connect it properly to the single zone

vrf_single_zone.prompt: Design a VRF HVAC system for efficient heating and cooling

vrf_ideal_load_single_zone.prompt: Generate the necessary HVAC objects for a single thermal zone using and IdealLoadsAirSystem to condition the zone. create a thermostate with constant heating setpoint at 21 degC and cooling setpoint at 24 degC.

vrf_heat_recovery.prompt: Design a VRF system with heat recovery for simultaneous heating and cooling in different zones

vrf_multi_zone_office.prompt: Design a VRF system to serve multiple office zones with independent temperature control
vrf_multi_zone_office.note: Clean base IDF without existing HVAC equipment

vrf_high_efficiency.prompt: Design a high-efficiency VRF system with advanced control strategies for energy savings
